name: Hardened Hearts
overview: Scripture reveals that hardened hearts are a spiritual condition marked by resistance to God's truth and mercy, as seen in God's sovereign act of hardening Pharaoh's heart to fulfill His purposes (Exodus 7:3; 9:12). The heart's deceitful and wicked nature (Jeremiah 17:9) contrasts with the transformative promise of God to replace a stony heart with a heart of flesh, enabling repentance and obedience (Ezekiel 36:26). True cleansing and spiritual renewal come through adherence to God's Word (Psalms 119:9) and the confession and forsaking of sin (Proverbs 28:13), highlighting the necessity of a soft heart responsive to God's grace.
